notes.title: Notice of Major Update Delay
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of ISEKI.

The major update we had planned to release within 2024 has been postponed to Spring 2025 to further enhance its quality.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to this update. However, this decision was made to ensure that ISEKI evolves into an even more exceptional experience.

Our team is fully committed to meeting your expectations, and we kindly ask for your patience a little while longer.

Thank you for your continued support of ISEKI.

notes.title: *ISEKI* Major Update: New "Survival Mode," More MTs, and Balance Adjustments!
notes.notes:
株式会社ワンコネクト is pleased to announce that a major update for the RPG *ISEKI*, currently available on Steam to positive reviews, will be released by the end of the year. This update will introduce a new mode called "Survival Mode," significantly increase the number of Memory Threads (MTs), and implement balance adjustments, providing players with a fresh experience.

**■ Background of the Update**  
Since its release, *ISEKI* has been well-received by many players. However, based on reviews and feedback, several areas for improvement were identified. In response, we have focused on strengthening the core system of the game to make it even more enjoyable for a wider audience.

**■ New "Survival Mode"**  
In the existing game mode, players would return to the base when their "maximum fuel" ran out, selecting MTs and increasing their fuel while expanding their exploration range. However, the newly implemented "Survival Mode" sets the maximum fuel to the highest value from the start, and each time players return to base, both MTs and fuel will reset. This introduces a roguelike element, adding a heightened sense of tension to the gameplay.

**■ Expansion of Memory Threads (MTs)**  
Memory Threads (MTs), which players equip during battles, have a significant impact on playstyle. With this update, the number of MTs will increase two to three times, and the range of their abilities will be more varied, allowing for deeper customization. This will enable players to enjoy even more diverse tactics.

**■ Extensive Balance Adjustments**  
In order to provide players with new experiences, we will also be making extensive balance adjustments.

**■ Additional Convenient Features**  
In response to player requests, we are also implementing timely updates with useful features.

Look forward to the exciting evolution of *ISEKI*!  
We will continue to value player feedback and further refine the game. Enjoy new modes, new challenges, and an evolved gameplay experience!
